headline: Romania CFA Macroeconomic Confidence Index Plunges in October
summary: The CFA Society Romania macroeconomic confidence indicator registered a steep drop in October, signaling widespread pessimism regarding economic conditions and public finances despite the formation of a new government.
why: The CFA Romania indicator surveys certified financial analysts to gauge sentiment regarding industrial production, inflation, fiscal deficits, and the national currency.

impacts.name: Romania
impacts.why: A sharp decline in professional analyst sentiment signals deteriorating economic growth and fiscal outlook.
